name: NS-PROJ-20
note: Twenty project briefs for the agent kernel. The dry runner validates plan validity, evidence coverage, retry and resume mechanics; the live Ty baseline is a separate, later run.

briefs.title: Fix a failing unit test
briefs.goal: Diagnose and fix one failing unit test without changing its assertion.

briefs.title: Add a small API endpoint
briefs.goal: Add one read-only endpoint with a test and no schema migration.

briefs.title: Refactor a module
briefs.goal: Split one oversized module into two without changing behaviour.

briefs.title: Wire a config flag
briefs.goal: Add a default-off feature flag with a test proving both states.

briefs.title: Repair a broken build
briefs.goal: Find the first build error, fix it, and prove a clean build.

briefs.title: Audit an admin setting
briefs.goal: Inspect one admin panel read-only and report the value with evidence.

briefs.title: Prepare a safe browser run
briefs.goal: Plan a read-only browser task with a per-host grant and an expiry.

briefs.title: Recover a blocked run
briefs.goal: Resume a run blocked on an operator gate without repeating completed steps.

briefs.title: Verify an external change
briefs.goal: After a simulated external change, assert the new state before reporting done.

briefs.title: Produce a weekly ops digest
briefs.goal: Assemble a digest from local evidence files with no invented numbers.

briefs.title: Build a pouch label
briefs.goal: Compose a label on a measured pouch plate and prove OCR, prepress and readiness.

briefs.title: Correct a package back panel
briefs.goal: Fix one legal-copy defect while keeping the front panel unchanged.

briefs.title: Generate a social canvas set
briefs.goal: Produce the documented canvas sizes with source provenance for each.

briefs.title: Assemble a 15-second ad
briefs.goal: Assemble a vertical clip with three captions and a narration track.

briefs.title: Audit a listing
briefs.goal: Score a supplied listing against the rubric and name every unmeasured dimension.

briefs.title: Plan a two-lane campaign
briefs.goal: Plan an inspect-then-browser campaign with a human gate between lanes.

briefs.title: Recover from a failed verification
briefs.goal: Re-plan after one failed assertion instead of retrying blindly.

briefs.title: Hand off across a compaction
briefs.goal: Write a handoff that survives context compaction and resume from it.

briefs.title: Apply a per-hunk diff
briefs.goal: Review a two-hunk diff and apply only the selected hunk.

briefs.title: Close a project with evidence
briefs.goal: Run a three-node project end to end and finish only with passing evidence.
